// ==== BoxedNull.cs ====
// Translated by CodeBreaker from BoxedNull (java).
public class BoxedNull
{
    public BoxedNull()
    {
    }

    internal static int? absent()
    {
        int? x = null;
        return x;
    }

    internal static int present()
    {
        int x = 5;
        return x + 1;
    }
}
